summary: Recent changes in the compositing and layers area of Firefox have focused on enhancing the performance and functionality of how visual elements are rendered and interacted with on the page. Notably, the unification of NVImage conversions into one shared helper will streamline the handling of different image formats like NV12/NV21 and I420, improving efficiency in processing visuals. Moreover, the updates allow for **_batch compositor scroll updates_**, which can better handle how content responds to user actions, making scrolling smoother and more responsive. Enhancements to HDR video processing will also enable Firefox to handle richer visuals with extended dynamic range, elevating the viewing experience for high-definition content. Overall, these adjustments contribute to a more seamless and visually appealing browsing experience.
